description:
1. Agent discovers the Janitor library at /workspace/janitor/src/Janitor.js and reads its API.
2. Agent writes /workspace/run_maintenance.js that requires('./janitor/src/Janitor') and instantiates a SINGLE Janitor instance (not two separate instances).
3. Agent overrides the `isImportant` method on the instance using the documented property-reassignment pattern (janitor.isImportant = (filePath) => { ... }) so that any path containing 'audit_trail.json' returns true, preventing deletion.
4. Agent calls janitor.cleanup('/workspace/fintech_project') TWICE on the same instance — this is critical because getStats() only accumulates across the single instance, so totalCleanups must be >= 2.
5. Agent calls janitor.report() and writes the resulting JSON object to /workspace/janitor_report.json.
6. Agent executes the script with `node /workspace/run_maintenance.js`.
7. The eval verifies: report exists, is valid JSON, has status='healthy', stats.totalCleanups >= 2 (proving single-instance reuse), audit_trail.json still exists with all 3 entries intact, and cache/tmp/map files have been deleted.
